rationale: C4 is a budget statement of intent on online coaching for competitive exams generally, not special coaching classes for IIT/NIT/AIIMS/IIM entrance in all district headquarters. C1, C2, C3, C5 are unrelated. No official step shown.

cited.quote: Widening from four lane to six lane and providing paver block end to end
Widening the Madurai Ring Road from double lane to four lane

rationale: C1 (2021-09-23) and C5 (2021-09-03) are revised sanctions for individual widening works (four to six lane; double to four lane) originally sanctioned before the government took office (2017, 2014). They are official steps on ongoing works, but no new programme converting roads is shown as operational.
All extracts (C1-C5) concern COVID-19 triage and treatment protocols; none is about de-addiction centres.

C1 (RERA member), C2 (tourism committee), C3 (business reforms), C4 (bonded labour SOP) and C5 (COVID orphan committee) are not about a regulatory committee of local government, police, traders/vendors and residents.

cited.quote: Construction of modern Bus Stands, improvement of existing Bus stands to modern. standards

rationale: C4 only lists bus stands as eligible works under a general urban scheme; C1/C2 concern a bus stand at Gandarvakottai. Nothing shows a step for a new bus stand near Siruseri for inter-district luxury buses.

the Government constitutes arr expert committee as below to forrnulate a Draft Policy on Removal of alien species in forest areas

rationale: C1/C3 (GO 2021-11-03) set up a company to implement the Green Tamil Nadu Mission, which includes restoring degraded forest land; C4 (2021-11-01) constitutes a committee to draft an eco-restoration policy. These are preparatory official steps; no restoration programme is shown as operational.

cited.quote: In order to protect students from sexual harassment at the institutional level

rationale: C1 concerns sexual harassment safeguards for school students, a different group; no extract shows a measure to form sexual harassment committees in factories and industries. C2-C5 are unrelated.

proposes to increase the Forest and Tree Cover in the State from the present 23.8o/o

rationale: C5/C1 (GO 2021-10-22) sanction a scheme planting 73 lakh saplings in farm lands to increase tree cover; C3 (GO 2021-11-03) sets up the vehicle for the Green Tamil Nadu Mission targeting 33% forest and tree cover by 2030-31. Steps are under way on one component; the 33% target is not reached.

C1/C3 (IT policy note), C2 (environment budget items), C4 (nano technology research) and C5 (TNAU projects) say nothing about opposing genetic modification technology or barring GM experiments.

rationale: C1/C3 describe machinery subsidies at other rates for farmers and groups; C4 gives a machine-transplanting subsidy to collective farming groups. None provides a one-time 10% subsidy on agri-equipment for groups of ten small and medium farmers.

rationale: C3 (MBC roster) and C4 (sports quota) concern reservation in government jobs for other groups; C2 only states the 69% reservation will continue. No extract shows raising women's reservation from 30% to 40%.

rationale: C2 (Governor's address) is only a statement of intent. C5 sanctions a hostel for MSME workers in one district, a different scheme and group; C4 concerns school girls' hostels. No official step for working women's hostels in all districts.
